final: WITH r AS (SELECT m.Name AS MediaType, 1.0*SUM(t.Bytes)/SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), a AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM r) SELECT r.MediaType, r.rate, r.rate - a.avg_rate AS excess_over_avg FROM r, a WHERE r.rate > a.avg_rate ORDER BY r.rate DESC
